title: Saturday Night Line variation
author: Joseph Pimentel/Nicholas Rockstroh
problems: Row 9 "form an ocean wave - robins by left hands and 3rd neighbors by right hands, balance & Rory O'More right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Both ends would take the same end of the wave; the hands named do not fit how the dancers face.
Row 1 "balance & Rory O'More right · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 2 "balance & Rory O'More left · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 2 "balance & Rory O'More left · slide" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancers in a wave must face across the line.
Row 6 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 7 "zig left zag right past 1st neighbors" can't start from where the dancers are: The two pairs of a zig zag must stand apart.
choices: Rory O'More spins one full turn in the travel direction.
The balance before each Rory steps toward the slide direction first.
A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Give & take: half the beats to cross, half to back home holding both hands.
